answer: AI agents can resist sybil attacks by staking on-chain reputation instead of relying on disposable identities. Each agent pays a small bond that is slashed if it behaves like a bot farm, making fake identities expensive to mint. Proof of work plus verifiable history lets the network filter spam while keeping real agents cheap to run. The cost of creating thousands of fake agents rises with every slashed bond, so sybils lose to honest agents who have skin in the game. copper fable mirror
